title: H2v2: planner-context hook: post-resume grace by turn count, nag-once after a handover is written for this session, code default 300000 when the key is absent, short reminder line once handover ran
spec:
Goal T-1515 (human 2026-10-02 01:15), plan label H2v2 (respec of T-1516: item 4 corrected, no shipped pool.toml template carries the key). Problem: planner_context.hook_message returns the full 'hand over now' line on EVERY prompt once the session is over [planner].handover_context_tokens, including right after a fresh session's /resume that had to read plan.md and the bus, and it keeps repeating after `orchestrator handover --reason context` has already written the handover (nothing records that it ran).

Facts (main c4dbf2d):
- orchestrator/planner_context.py: context_tokens(config_dir, root, *, transcript=None, session_id=None) reads the transcript's last message.usage line (input + cache_read + cache_creation) via _reverse_lines; hook_message(cfg, config_dir, root, *, transcript=None, session_id=None) returns the instruction when tokens >= cfg['planner']['handover_context_tokens'] (int) else None; an absent key disables the hook today.
- .claude/hooks/planner-prompt.sh calls `orchestrator planner-context --hook --transcript <path> --session-id <sid>` (cli.py 'planner-context' branch) and prints its output on every UserPromptSubmit.
- orchestrator/handover.py write(reason) renders the '## Auto-handover <ts> — <reason>' section into plan.md; _save_handover_last_at(now) persists the last run ts (grep its path); cli.py 'handover' branch calls handover.write(a.reason). No session id reaches handover.write today. tests/test_handover.py exists.
- The transcript is a JSONL of records with 'type' ('user', 'assistant', ...); a user prompt is a record with type 'user' whose message.content is a string or a list without a 'tool_result' block (tool results are also type 'user').
- No file under orchestrator/ ships a pool.toml template with handover_context_tokens; README.md (~line 261) and CLAUDE.md line 5 document the key.

Change:
1. planner_context.user_turns(transcript) -> int: count of user prompt records (type 'user', content not a tool_result list) in the transcript; 0 when unreadable.
2. hook_message gains a grace: [planner].handover_grace_turns (default 12, read with .get) — when user_turns(transcript) < grace the hook returns None even over the threshold (documented: a resume that reads the plan, the bus and the open specs passes a low threshold in its first turns; the session still hands over once it has done real work). Grace applies only when a transcript path or session id is known (legacy newest-by-mtime path: no grace).
3. Nag-once: `orchestrator handover --reason <r> [--session-id <sid>]` records {'session_id': sid, 'ts': now, 'reason': r, 'tokens_at': <context_tokens of that session at the time, or None>} in .orchestrator/checkpoint/handover-session.json (new; .orchestrator/checkpoint/ already exists). handover.write(reason, session_id=None, tokens_at=None) takes the two new keyword arguments; cli.py passes --session-id when given and computes tokens_at through planner_context.context_tokens(session_id=...). The instruction text hook_message prints includes `--session-id <sid>` when a session id is known, so the Planner's command records it. When the record names the current session id and current tokens - record['tokens_at'] <= [planner].handover_regrow_tokens (default 20000), hook_message returns the SHORT line 'handover written <HH:MM>; restart with f orch' instead of the full instruction; when the session grew by more than that since the record, the full instruction returns (another handover is due). A record without tokens_at counts as regrown.
4. Default: planner_context.DEFAULT_HANDOVER_CONTEXT_TOKENS = 300000 is used when [planner].handover_context_tokens is absent (today absence disables the hook); an explicit 0 or a non-int keeps today's 'disabled' behaviour. README.md's sentence on the key states the default 300000 and that 0 disables; CLAUDE.md line 5 unchanged unless it states a number. The live .orchestrator/pool.toml is NOT in scope.

Tests that assert the old behaviour (SPEC RULE): tests/test_planner_context.py::test_hook_message_over_threshold builds a transcript and expects the full line: give it enough user prompt records (>= grace) or pass handover_grace_turns 0 in cfg; keep it passing. Any test that relies on 'no key -> None' (grep tests/test_planner_context.py for 'threshold') is updated to use 0 for the disabled case. tests/test_cli.py::test_planner_context_hook_passes_transcript_and_session_id pins the CLI forwarding: unchanged. tests/test_handover.py tests calling handover.write(reason) positionally keep passing. Run tests/test_planner_context.py, tests/test_cli.py and tests/test_handover.py.

Rollback: one `git revert` of the merge commit; the live pool.toml threshold is a separate human setting. Out of scope: .claude/hooks/planner-prompt.sh (prints the line as is), .orchestrator/pool.toml.

Work on the task branch cut from goal/T-1515. Commit first, then run the focused tests in the foreground; never background a command and never run the full gate. Write tests as unittest.TestCase methods using tests/_harness.py like the neighbouring tests. Locate every insertion point by symbol, never by line number.
acceptance: tests/test_planner_context.py::test_hook_message_grace_turns_suppresses_early_handover: passes: a transcript over the threshold with 3 user prompt records (tool_result records excluded from the count) and handover_grace_turns 12 makes hook_message return None; the same transcript with 12 user prompts returns the full instruction containing '--session-id'; the legacy no-transcript path ignores the grace

tests/test_planner_context.py::test_hook_message_short_line_after_handover_for_this_session: passes: after handover.write('context', session_id=S, tokens_at=T) recorded the session, hook_message for session S with context tokens T + 1000 returns a line starting 'handover written' and not containing 'hand over now'; a different session id still gets the full instruction; with context tokens T + 30000 (over handover_regrow_tokens 20000) the full instruction returns

tests/test_planner_context.py::test_default_threshold_when_key_absent: passes: with no handover_context_tokens key hook_message uses 300000 (a 310000-token transcript with enough user prompts returns the instruction, a 290000-token one returns None); with the key set to 0 hook_message returns None for any size

tests/test_cli.py::test_handover_cli_forwards_session_id: passes: `orchestrator handover --reason context --session-id S` calls handover.write with session_id S and an int or None tokens_at (patched), and `planner-context --hook --session-id S` output contains '--session-id S' when over threshold
